events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver

RIDER: Good news — your $5.00 cancellation fee is being refunded in full as a Ryde voucher.

What decided it: your driver cancelled and claimed you didn't show, but the record shows he wasn't at the pickup long enough to meet the required wait time. He marked himself as arrived and stayed nearby for only about 7 minutes 50 seconds, which falls short of the 8 minutes required.

Nothing is being held against your account, and no further action is needed from you. The voucher will be applied to your account in the usual way.

DRIVER: Outcome: the $5.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider is being refunded in full as a Ryde voucher.

Why: you marked yourself as arrived at the pickup, but the records show you stayed within the pickup area for only about 7 minutes 50 seconds — just short of the 8 minutes required before a no-show cancellation can be charged. Because that wait requirement wasn't met, the fee can't stand.

This is a refund of the fee only. No action is being taken against your account, and you can keep accepting trips as normal. Use the arrived/ wait timer in the app to its full 8 minutes next time.
